notes: Chat and necks: new chat lines appear at once as plain text with the newest at the bottom, dead players can chat and see the chat, and a merc keeps his HUD and the chat in the scope and the drone. Spies can neck a merc on stairs, while he jumps or just after he lands, at the end of his berserk spin and through the stagger after he sprints into a wall or hits someone; when a neck is possible the interact key necks instead of using a switch, panel or the gadget stock. Mercs can start the berserk spin during those staggers. Necks need the spy and the host on this version.
